_about: The recurring voices of HelloBuh's stories (docs/voices.md). A character keeps its id, Gemini voice AND direction string in every story: change one and it's a different person. scripts/tts.py reads `voice`, `name` (the speaker name Gemini sees), `profile` (the acting direction) and `post` (an ffmpeg filter run on every take, before loudness). `fallback` is a Kokoro-82M voice for when Gemini is out of quota (scripts/voice.py; tempo 1.0, rate 1.0: never the old 1.45x). `post` is EQ only; never asetrate (docs/voices.md "Realism"). `tempo` and `rate` (optional; the Roblox narrator only, owner-approved 2026-11-10) speed up the WHOLE raw take before anything else: `tempo` = atempo (pitch kept), then `rate` = a resample that raises pitch, formants and tempo together (docs/voices.md "The Roblox narrator"). `color` is the character's caption colour (scripts/story_track.py; a story's cast `color` wins), matched to the character's look and role (owner, 2026-11-10: it should "match" the vibe of the character), with `color_why`; all of them read on the captions' dark outline and stay apart in pairs under red-green and blue-yellow colour blindness (docs/voices.md "Caption colours"). `model` (optional) locks the character to one TTS model: tts.py never voices it with another (docs/voices.md "Drift gate": a different model is a different-sounding person). `reads_as` ({sex, age: [lo, hi]}) is the age and sex the voice must be heard as at first hearing (STANDARDS 2.7; scripts/voice_contrast.py asks a blind listener and the pitch; no sex = a kid, whose sex the check leaves alone).

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.color_why: white: the narrator carries the story, so every other colour means someone else is talking
narrator.profile: A bubbly nine-year-old kid, fast, bright and energetic, telling a friend an amazing story; not whispery, breathy or soft
narrator.from: owner 2026-11-10: "can we use this voice actually, the one used in dog on the hill v2 (held: needs your OK) in the preview?" = Pip (Leda, this profile, natural tempo, no speed-up, no pitch; claude/story-cine-2 58fa5da, voiced on gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts)
narrator.notes: Pip exactly as heard in Dog on the Hill v2: natural tempo (no tempo/rate/semitones/stretch), no pause cap; takes performed continuously and re-taken, never trimmed. Earlier picks kept for history: narrator_sleepover (k4, 1.1x +1 st), narrator_roblox (Orus x1.45). Recipe, from the Dog on the Hill session (voices/recipes/pip.md on claude/story-cine-2): one single-speaker flash-lite request, "[profile]", a blank line, the lines separated by blank lines; plain sentence case (`plain_say`: the stress CAPS in `say` are lowered for this voice), no ellipses (they made it stop and whisper); measured ~235 Hz, ~3.2 words/s.

narrator_roblox.name: Narrator
narrator_roblox.color_why: white: the narrator carries the story, so every other colour means someone else is talking
narrator_roblox.profile: A deep-voiced American guy in his twenties telling a crazy true story from his own life, first person, straight into a phone mic; confident, punchy and matter-of-fact, every sentence driven forward with no gaps between sentences, a little smug, landing each line hard on the last word; full, close and clear, not an announcer, not an audiobook, never whispery; steady natural speaking pace
narrator_roblox.from: owner 2026-11-10: "s3_gemini_orus.mp3 is good" (docs/voice_search.md "Closest match": the Roblox-story voice is ElevenLabs Adam played ~1.45x faster; Orus x1.45 has its melody and nasal band)
narrator_roblox.notes: The Roblox-story first-person narrator, and the default `narrator` since 2026-11-10. ONE narrator says every line, quotes included (owner), so characters are rarely voiced. tts.py plays every raw take `tempo` 0.95 (atempo, pitch kept) then `rate` 1.45 faster (a resample: pitch, formants and tempo all rise, no pitch correction) BEFORE trimming, slicing or the take gate, so the gate judges the pauses as they are heard; then every silence inside the take is shortened to `pause_cap` 0.12 s, in its silent middle only (owner: "its fine to have those cuts, i didnt even notice", on s3's gap cut); words are never cut. The owner-approved exception to "never pitch-shift a voice", for this narrator only (docs/STANDARDS.md). Recipe: voices/recipes/narrator_roblox.md
narrator_roblox.model_hint: gemini-3.8-flash-tts, single speaker, the profile as the bracketed prefix, lines separated by blank lines (voices/recipes/narrator_roblox.md)

storyteller.name: Storyteller
storyteller.color_why: pale lilac: a late-night story told close (white whenever she is the story's narrator)
storyteller.profile: the storyteller: a woman in her thirties telling a friend a story late at night, low and close, plain and conversational, never an announcer; she lets the strange detail land with a small pause before it
storyteller.notes: The old default narrator (Erinome until 2026-11-10, recast to Despina: Erinome was heard as 'announcer'/'audiobook' in three listening tests, Despina 9/10). Third-person framing for serious mystery stories; the default narrator is now the kid (`narrator`).

milo.name: Buh
milo.color_why: cyan: Steve's shirt (Milo is the default Steve skin)
milo.profile: Buh, our hero (played by the default Steve skin): a sixteen-year-old boy, friendly and quick, a little nervous; he jokes when he's scared, and goes quiet and serious when it matters
milo.from: the AI-dilemma voice for Claude, the trailer's Buh (renamed Milo, owner 2026-11-10) and the movie's brothers
milo.notes: First person. Range: scared/funny ('Okay. That's... not normal.'), serious, whispering. Never sped up. Owner 2026-11-10: the hero is called Buh again, and nobody ever says his name aloud (it only appears as in-game text: chat, death screen, name tag).

elder.name: Elder
elder.color_why: warm amber: an old villager's brown-gold robe in lantern light
elder.profile: the village elder: an old man in his seventies, tired, low and a little rough in the throat, speaks slowly and quietly; he has seen this before, and that is what makes him unsettling
elder.from: the trailer's Highkeeper (Grok in the AI Shorts is the same voice, directed deep and heroic)
elder.notes: Librarian, grandfather, the one who knows the rule. Slow on purpose: give him short sentences. Recast Algenib -> Charon 2026-11-10 (realism test: Charon 'genuinely aged', Algenib 'sounds like a filter, younger than seventy').

child.name: Kid
child.color_why: sunny yellow: small, bright and quick
child.profile: a real village kid, about nine: small and quick, breath catching, words tumbling out a little too fast; scared but trying to be brave
child.notes: Recast Leda+2 st -> Laomedeia unshifted 2026-11-10: every listening test put the pitch lift last ('chipmunk', 'warble'); Laomedeia unshifted was heard as a real child. Never pitch-shift him.

smith.name: Smith
smith.color_why: iron grey: the anvil, and the iron golem he also voices
smith.profile: the blacksmith: a big, gruff man in his fifties, low and blunt, short sentences, no patience for nonsense, a soft heart he hides
smith.notes: Also the iron golem's voice if a golem ever talks (direct it slower, fewer words, and no post change).

stranger.name: Stranger
stranger.color_why: dusk violet: the hooded stranger at the edge of render distance, a little enderman
stranger.profile: a mysterious hooded stranger: very old and gravelly, a slow low whisper, knows a terrible secret and says less than he knows
stranger.notes: The wandering trader, the one at the edge of render distance. Keep his lines under ten words where possible. Voice moved Charon -> Algenib (gravelly) 2026-11-10 when Charon became the elder; audition him before his first story.

villain.name: Villain
villain.color_why: redstone red: the danger colour; the only red in the cast
villain.profile: the villain: a man in his forties, cold, flat and quiet, perfectly calm, never shouts, sounds faintly amused; the threat is in how polite he is
villain.notes: Herobrine-type, the thing in the fog, the one behind the twist. Calm beats loud: never direct him to yell.

mom.name: Mom
mom.color_why: warm peach: home, the hearth, the normal life before the strange thing
mom.profile: A warm mother around forty, low, calm and steady
mom.from: owner 2026-11-11: "mom D / grandma J" (r:r3dabdb), from the audition brand/auditions/2026-11-11_mom_grandma (branch claude/audition-mom-grandma): Pulcherrima, 176 Hz, 3.5 st under Pip
mom.notes: Home scenes, the normal life before the strange thing. Her ordinary line is often the scariest one in the twist. History: was Sulafat ("Milo's mom: a warm woman in her forties, gentle and tired, loving, calls from another room; a little worried under it") until 2026-11-11; the owner: "The moms voice is too similar to narrator" (r:rc31bfe): Sulafat sat at Pip's own 215 Hz, speaker similarity 0.85. The profile is the one-clause bracket the audition used, verbatim (3.8 reads a long bracket aloud).

mom_saltmouth.name: Mom
mom_saltmouth.color_why: soft rose: a different home from Hushwell's Mom
mom_saltmouth.profile: A warm mother around forty, low, calm and steady
mom_saltmouth.from: owner 2026-11-11: "A is fine" (r:rd8f6ce), candidate A of the audition brand/auditions/2026-11-11_mom_grandma (branch claude/audition-mom-grandma): Kore, f0 180 Hz, 0.755 similarity to Pip, the furthest Mom from Pip
mom_saltmouth.notes: Saltmouth's Mom (The Bell in the Window), not Buh's Mom in Hushwell (`mom`): one voice per character (STANDARDS 7a).

grandma.name: Grandma
grandma.color_why: warm gold: the family's elder (Gold for the Portal's Grandma colour)
grandma.profile: An old grandmother in her seventies, warm, slow and a little dry
grandma.from: owner 2026-11-11: "mom D / grandma J" (r:r3dabdb), from the audition brand/auditions/2026-11-11_mom_grandma: Autonoe, 237 Hz (heard as a woman of 65-85 by the blind listener; furthest from Pip of all candidates, 0.66)
grandma.notes: An old woman, never a man: earlier Grandmas (Gacrux, Vindemiatrix) read low and gravelly, as a man (owner: "Grandma sounds like a dude still", r:rc31bfe). The profile is the audition's one-clause bracket, verbatim.

friend.name: Max
friend.color_why: lime: loud, quick and loyal, all energy (a slime's green)
friend.profile: Milo's best friend: a sixteen-year-old boy, loud, excitable and loyal, talks fast, jokes, always up for it
friend.notes: The sidekick and comic relief; he goes first into the cave. Fenrir is brighter and faster than Milo's Achird, so the two read apart in an exchange.

_spares.Achernar: soft, very breathy woman: a ghost, someone sick

pip.name: Pip
pip.color_why: white: Pip is a narrator voice (a kid telling his own story)
pip.profile: A bubbly nine-year-old kid, fast, bright and energetic, telling a friend an amazing story; not whispery, breathy or soft
pip.from: Pip, Dog on the Hill voices v3 (owner 2026-11-10: 'i kinda like the pip here'; the 1.5x audition takes were 'too sped up')
pip.notes: Pip's voice (Dog on the Hill v3; owner: 'i kinda like the pip here', and again 'what about pip? i liked the audio i sent earlier'). Use for Pip and Pip-like young narrators when the story's kid is younger and sweeter; the Roblox narrator (`narrator`, Orus x1.45) is the default. In Good Boy's take the same voice read 'so high pitched and annoying' (owner): keep the bubbly-nine-year-old direction and natural tempo, never a pitch lift.
pip.model_hint: gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts worked for Pip (single speaker, all narrator lines in one request, separated by blank lines, the profile as a short bracketed prefix); 3.1-flash-tts with the structured prompt is the default in tts.py

puck_kid.name: Narrator (kid Puck, alt)
puck_kid.profile: Read this as a twelve-year-old boy telling his friends a funny story: quick, excited, mid-pitch, not squeaky; full volume, not whispery or breathy. Take a short breath between sentences.
puck_kid.from: Good Boy narrator audition, owner 2026-11-10: "kid puck is fine" (Leda was 'so high pitched and annoying'; wants a kid 'like the roblox shorts but more refined')
puck_kid.notes: No post filter, no tempo or pitch change. Measured ~235 Hz median on the audition (240-330 per line in a story), ~3.4 words/s while speaking. The short breath between sentences is what lets the splitter cut cleanly (voice_edges.py: 0 cut). No ellipses. Owner later: 'er that does not sound right'; Pip is 'a lot a lot better'. Alternative only.
puck_kid.model_hint: single-speaker requests; gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview first, gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts on 429 (same voice)

buh.from: the AI-dilemma voice for Claude, the trailer's Buh (renamed Milo, owner 2026-11-10) and the movie's brothers
buh.notes: First person. Range: scared/funny ('Okay. That's... not normal.'), serious, whispering. Never sped up. Owner 2026-11-10: the hero is called Buh again, and nobody ever says his name aloud (it only appears as in-game text: chat, death screen, name tag).

narrator_sleepover.name: Narrator
narrator_sleepover.color_why: white: the narrator carries the story, so every other colour means someone else is talking
narrator_sleepover.profile: A kid telling a spooky-funny story at a sleepover, fast and gleeful, every sentence a bit more excited, one breath, punching only the capitalised key word; full voice, never whispering
narrator_sleepover.from: owner 2026-11-10: "i kidna like the sleepover" (brand/voice_samples/kid k4_sleepover), "maybe 1.1 with +1 pitch", "C and D feel like they have weird artifacts in them, so A sounds the best" (A = rubberband tempo 1.1, +1 semitone, nothing else)
narrator_sleepover.notes: The owner's pick from 2026-11-10 22:48 to 23:05 (k4 sleepover, rubberband 1.1, +1 st), replaced the same night by Pip as in Dog on the Hill v2.
narrator_sleepover.model_hint: k4_sleepover was voiced on gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts in Pip's layout: "[profile]", a blank line, the text as one paragraph (brand/voice_samples/kid/raw/k4_sleepover_raw.wav.json); the brand session's direction said "punching the key word", here "only the capitalised key word" (STANDARDS 2.000: one stress per sentence)
